title: Agents
subtitle: When adding a new Agent, XClaw will copy the main Agent's workspace files and runtime auth setup. The configuration can be modified through a dialog.
gatewayWarning: Gateway service is not running. Agent/channel changes may take a moment to apply.

workbench.title: Agents
workbench.emptyDescription: Create an agent first or pick one from the bundled market. This phase focuses on a real workbench structure and honest file boundaries, not fake editors.

browse.agentsDescription: Discover and select an agent first, then use the workbench on the right for overview and persona files.
browse.agentsToolbarHint: This mode is for browsing and creating. Deep edits stay in the workbench on the right.
browse.marketDescription: The market handles discovery and install. The right pane confirms source, naming, and install.

detail.emptyAgentDescription: Choose an agent from the left to open its overview and persona workbench.
detail.emptyMarketDescription: Choose a template from the left to review its source, naming, and install actions.

sourceList.emptyDescription: Try a different keyword or create a new agent.

overview.agentDirHint: The runtime directory is visible for context only. Editing auth-profiles.json or models.json stays out of scope.
overview.noChannels: This agent is not assigned to any channel accounts yet. Channel editing still belongs to the Channels page.
overview.channelsDescription: Bound accounts still stay managed on the Channels page. This pane shows the current facts only.

binding.runtimeDescription: Show the current Gateway facts only. This is not a fake control console.
binding.channelDescription: Channel ownership is still maintained in the Channels page. This pane only summarizes and links out.

persona.title: Persona workspace
persona.description: This tab works against the real workspace root files. Editing, upload, create, rename, and delete stay inside a controlled boundary instead of pretending a textarea is enough.
persona.fileListDescription: Only built-in persona files are shown here. Editing happens in a dialog.
persona.workspaceOnlyDescription: Persona editing will stay inside the workspace root and will not mix with runtime files.
persona.runtimeReadonlyDescription: Files such as auth-profiles.json and models.json remain in agentDir and are shown as facts only.
persona.previewDescription: Edit the real file content directly here. Runtime files remain read-only.
persona.noContent: This file is empty or content is not available in the current phase.
persona.emptyFiles: No editable workspace files are available yet.
persona.editorReadyTitle: Workspace file actions are wired to real files
persona.editorReadyDescription: Editing, upload, and file creation now write only to the current agent workspace root and never touch runtime files in agentDir.
persona.emptyDescription: Select or create an agent first, then enter the persona workspace.
persona.bootstrapHint: Built-in bootstrap files can be edited, but cannot be renamed or deleted.
persona.customFileHint: Custom files can be edited, renamed, and deleted.

createDialog.title: Create persona file
createDialog.description: Only controlled text files can be created under the workspace root.

renameDialog.title: Rename persona file
renameDialog.description: Renaming only affects the current agent workspace root.

deleteDialog.title: Delete persona file
deleteDialog.message: Delete “{{name}}”? This changes the current agent workspace file set immediately.

discardDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discardDialog.message: The current file has unsaved edits. Switching now will lose them.

market.catalogDescription: {{count}} curated templates are bundled in this build and install directly into the workbench. Source stays frozen for verification only.
market.noRole: This template has no role description yet.
market.installReadyDescription: Confirm the new agent name, then install. The template is copied into a new workspace while source details stay for verification.
market.highlightsDescription: These highlights are parsed from the template's source SOUL.md so you can judge fit before installing.
market.detailsDescription: Details are derived from the template source instead of directory-style metadata.
market.emptyDescription: Select a bundled template from the left first.
market.sourceHint: Source details are for verification. The primary action is installing.
market.sourceLanguageHint: Template content comes from the upstream source file. If the upstream template has no localized version, the original language is preserved here.
market.emptySearchDescription: Try another keyword or refresh the catalog. Only controlled entries are accepted.

createDialog.title: Create agent
createDialog.description: Create a new agent by name. XClaw will copy the main agent's workspace bootstrap files and runtime auth setup.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent
deleteDialog.message: Delete "{{name}}" from XClaw? This permanently deletes the agent and its XClaw-managed workspace, runtime, and session files from disk.

settingsDialog.title: {{name}} Settings
settingsDialog.description: Update the agent name, the model override, and review read-only channel ownership.
settingsDialog.modelDescription: Saving persists the override to agent config; model changes are applied asynchronously in the background.
settingsDialog.useDefaultModelDescription: Remove this agent override and inherit the default model again.
settingsDialog.modelsLoadFailed: Failed to load models. Try again shortly.
settingsDialog.modelsEmpty: No models are available right now.
settingsDialog.channelsDescription: This list is read-only. Manage channel accounts and bindings in the Channels page.
settingsDialog.channelsManagedInChannels: This agent is linked to channel types. Manage exact account bindings in the Channels page.
settingsDialog.noChannels: No channels are assigned to this agent yet.

removeChannelDialog.title: Remove Channel
removeChannelDialog.message: Remove {{name}} from XClaw? This deletes the current channel configuration.

toast.agentUpdatedApplying: Agent saved. Model changes are being applied in the background.
toast.marketInstallSucceeded: Template installed as a new agent
